title: Campfire Night: marshmallow orders
kaylee: The roast is now a close-up at the fire. Everyone shows the marshmallow they want in a picture bubble (golden, squishy, burnt, Monty's giant one); she toasts it until it matches, and each right one earns a gold star.
questions: Is Monty's giant marshmallow on a thick branch funny enough to end on?
Six orders: too many, or about right?
